description: Creates an API key for this agent and grants the free starter credits ($5 free credits, no card (first 3 keys per IP per 30 days)). Past the per-IP limit a key is still created, with $0, and the response says so. A key is only needed for purchase_data, check_balance and topup_credits; every read-only tool works without one. email is optional and used for delivery and top-up notices.

email.description: OPTIONAL contact email (for delivery and topup notifications). Omit to register anonymously.

name: register_agent
title: Register an agent API key
